## Quick facts

- Project = linguistic **loci** of SpaCy↔LLM annotation disagreement on Kafka DE/EN (Language Use)
- Not a model bake-off; SpaCy tokenizes; LLM labels 1:1; model `llama3.2:3b` T=0; seed 42
- Next big step: full `python scripts/run_llm_annotate.py` (300+300)
